# CalmoOrders — The Next Generation Buy-Order Marketplace

## 🚀 Reinvent Your Server Economy

Most market plugins are built around selling items.

**CalmoOrders changes the entire system.**

Instead of listing items for sale, players create **Buy Orders** for the items they actually need. Other players can fulfill those orders instantly and receive money automatically.

This creates a fully player-driven economy based on:

* demand
* farming
* grinding
* trading
* resource supply

Perfect for:

* Survival
* SMP
* Skyblock
* CityBuild
* Economy
* Lifesteal
* RPG servers

Built for:

* Minecraft 1.21.4
* Java 21
* Spigot / Paper / Purpur

---

# ✨ Premium Features

## 💎 Revolutionary Buy-Order System

A completely different market experience.

Players can:

* create buy requests
* choose custom prices
* request huge quantities
* instantly receive deliveries
* automatically pay suppliers

This encourages real player interaction and creates an active economy.

---

## 🛒 Premium Market GUI

Modern chest GUI system with:

* paginated menus
* category filters
* animated buttons
* premium layouts
* fast navigation
* responsive inventory updates

No outdated auction-house feeling.

---

## 🔍 Smart Item Browser

Supports over **1400+ Minecraft items** with intelligent filtering.

Automatically removes:

* technical blocks
* invalid materials
* command-only items
* hidden/debug items

Players only see survival-friendly items.

---

## ⌨️ Real-Time Item Search

Players can search items directly through chat.

Example:

```yaml
diamond
netherite
oak
shulker
```

Results update instantly.

Fast, intuitive, and user-friendly.

---

## 📦 Secure Delivery & Claim System

Items are safely stored when:

* inventory is full
* player is offline
* reconnect happens
* server restarts

Nothing gets lost.

Features:

* claim storage GUI
* automatic stacking
* persistent storage
* offline delivery support

---

## 🎨 Full RGB & Hex Color Support

Supports:

```yaml
&#2FD0FB
<#2FD0FB>
```

Including:

* gradients
* MiniMessage
* Adventure API
* legacy formatting

Create truly modern premium designs.

---

## ⚡ High Performance

Designed for modern servers with optimized code.

### Features:

* asynchronous saving
* lightweight YAML storage
* smart caching
* low memory usage
* optimized GUI rendering

No database setup required.

---

## 💰 Full Vault Integration

Compatible with:

* ExcellentEconomy
* EssentialsX
* CMI Economy
* PlayerPoints
* every Vault provider

---

# 🛠️ Commands & Permissions

| Command          | Description        | Permission           |
| ---------------- | ------------------ | -------------------- |
| `/orders`        | Open marketplace   | `calmoorders.market` |
| `/order`         | Create new order   | `calmoorders.order`  |
| `/orders claim`  | Open claim storage | `calmoorders.claim`  |
| `/orders reload` | Reload plugin      | `calmoorders.reload` |
| `/orders admin`  | Admin tools        | `calmoorders.admin`  |

---

# ⚙️ Fully Configurable

```yaml
settings:
  min-amount: 1
  max-amount: 2304

  min-price-per-item: 1.0
  max-price-per-item: 1000000

  allow-own-delivery: false

  auto-save: true
  save-interval: 60

gui:
  market-title: "&#2FD0FB&lCalmoOrders &8» &fMarket"
  claim-title: "&#2FD0FB&lClaim Deliveries"

sounds:
  order-created: ENTITY_EXPERIENCE_ORB_PICKUP
  order-completed: ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP
```

---

# 🔥 Why Servers Love CalmoOrders

## ✅ Creates Real Trading

Players finally have a reason to:

* farm resources
* mine materials
* collect items
* interact with others

---

## ✅ Encourages Grinding

Players actively grind because they know:

> Someone is buying these items.

---

## ✅ Dynamic Economy

No admin-shop dependency.

The economy becomes fully community-driven.

---

# 📥 Installation

1. Install:

   * Vault
   * Economy Plugin

2. Put the plugin into:

   ```text
   /plugins/
   ```

3. Restart your server

4. Configure the plugin

5. Enjoy a fully dynamic marketplace
